summary: A 48 in (1.22 m) square banquet table is 30 in (0.77 m) high, seats 8 (2 per side) and takes a 120 in square linen or two 52x114 linens. A 6 ft picnic table with attached benches is about 72 x 60 in (1.83 x 1.52 m), 28 in (0.71 m) tall with 15 in seats, seats 6 and has an umbrella hole; a loose-bench version is a 6 ft x 28 in table with two 13 in-deep benches. Kids' tables are low: one rental house stocks a 30 x 72 in table at 21 in (0.53 m) for 6 to 8 small children; another lists 24 x 96 in at 24 in high (0.61 m); some adjust between 24, 29 and 36 in. Planners should leave room for chair pull-out around tables and put kids' tables where parents can see them.
